boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase outings for Loyola students, from the Lake Shore campus lakefront to free Chicago cultural sites.

cards.title: Walk the Lake Michigan walkway
cards.subtitle: Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Meet by the Information Commons and take an unhurried walk along Loyola’s Lake Michigan walkway; bring a friend and pause at the lakefront.
cards.short_summary: A campus lakefront walk with room for conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola identifies the Walkway Along Lake Michigan as a place for runs and walks with friends.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus walkway; check campus conditions before heading out.

cards.title: Take a shoreline walk at Loyola Beach
cards.subtitle: 1230 W. Greenleaf Ave., East Rogers Park
cards.notes: Use the nearly two-thirds-mile walking trail beside Loyola Beach for a low-key shoreline loop; swim only when lifeguards are on duty.
cards.short_summary: A public Lake Michigan beach with a walking trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District says Loyola Beach has a nearly two-thirds-mile walking trail and is open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Beach access is public; swimming is only permitted in season, 11 a.m.–7 p.m., in designated areas with lifeguards.

cards.title: Follow the dunes paths
cards.subtitle: Within Loyola Park, 1230 W. Greenleaf Ave.
cards.notes: Walk the paved paths and pier through the dunes, looking for shorebirds and native plants; stay on marked paths to protect the habitat.
cards.short_summary: A compact native-dune walk beside Lake Michigan.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District describes nearly seven acres of native dune habitat with paved trails, a pier, and sand paths.
cards.source_title: Loyola Beach Dunes Natural Area | Chicago Park District
cards.access_notes: Natural area is open daily from dawn to dusk; paved paths cover most of the site.

cards.title: Meet at Berger Park
cards.subtitle: 6205 N. Sheridan Rd., Edgewater
cards.notes: Bring a book, sketchpad, or simply a friend for a seated lakefront pause at Berger Park, then take a short walk through the grounds.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public park for a relaxed outdoor meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District lists Berger Park at 6205 N. Sheridan Road and gives daily park hours of 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Public park grounds are listed as open daily, 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; building hours differ.

cards.title: Browse the National Museum of Mexican Art
cards.subtitle: 1852 W. 19th St., Pilsen
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided gallery visit and compare notes on a favorite work afterward; the museum asks groups to coordinate visits in advance.
cards.short_summary: Free galleries devoted to Mexican art and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of Mexican Art states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | National Museum of Mexican Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and major holidays.

cards.title: See the Hyde Park Art Center galleries
cards.subtitle: 5020 S. Cornell Ave., Hyde Park
cards.notes: Drop in to view contemporary exhibitions, then use the visit as a prompt for a quick photo-free sketch or conversation about one piece.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary-art galleries open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyde Park Art Center says it is free and open to the public seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Hyde Park Art Center
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; check the center’s visit page for holiday and special-event changes.

cards.title: Explore the Hull-House Museum
cards.subtitle: 800 S. Halsted St., University of Illinois Chicago
cards.notes: Reserve a self-guided visit or walk in, then explore the historic home and Residents’ Dining Hall at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A free historic museum centered on social transformation.
cards.evidence_claim: Jane Addams Hull-House Museum states that admission is free and walk-ins are welcome.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Jane Addams Hull-House Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4:50 p.m., and Saturday, 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; reserve ahead if preferred.

cards.title: Visit the Renaissance Society
cards.subtitle: Cobb Hall, 5811 S. Ellis Ave., University of Chicago
cards.notes: Take the elevator to the fourth-floor gallery and spend time with the current exhibition; use the available seating and gallery texts.
cards.short_summary: Free contemporary-art exhibitions on the University of Chicago campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Renaissance Society states that all exhibitions and programs are free to attend and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Wednesday–Friday, noon–6 p.m., and Saturday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; it closes between exhibitions.

cards.title: Look through the ISAC Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: 1155 E. 58th St., University of Chicago
cards.notes: Make a self-guided visit to the archaeology galleries and choose one object to research together after you leave; individuals need no reservation.
cards.short_summary: Free-admission archaeology galleries at the University of Chicago.
cards.evidence_claim: The Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures states that its museum provides free admission.
cards.source_title: The ISAC Museum | Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures
cards.access_notes: Individuals need no reservation; museum hours are Tuesday–Thursday and Saturday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., plus Friday until 8 p.m.

cards.title: Stroll the Lincoln Park Conservatory
cards.subtitle: 2391 N. Stockton Dr., Lincoln Park
cards.notes: Reserve a free timed entry, then take a slow lap through the conservatory’s planted rooms and compare favorite foliage or flower details.
cards.short_summary: A free historic conservatory with year-round greenery.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District states that admission to Lincoln Park Conservatory is free.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Conservatory | Chicago Park District
cards.access_notes: Free timed reservations are required; check the Park District reservation link and current hours before visiting.
